$comment: Plank harness — TEAM-SHARED config. Commit this file.
Layer 3 (Permissions) + Layer 4 (Hooks) of the five-layer harness.
Personal tweaks go in settings.local.json (gitignored) — see the .example.
Tailored for: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript static app (npm). No backend/DB.

permissions.$comment_mode: acceptEdits: edits apply without a prompt, but consequential Bash (push, publish, deploy) still asks. Chosen because this repo auto-deploys to Vercel on push to main — full bypassPermissions would let an agent ship to prod unattended. Bump to bypassPermissions only if you detach the Vercel auto-deploy or move to a throwaway branch. Precedence: managed > project-local > project-shared > user.
permissions.$comment_allow: Pre-approved = runs without stopping. SAFE, reversible, read-or-verify only. Scoped to this repo's real tooling (npm + Vite + Vitest + tsc).
permissions.$comment_ask: Reversible-but-consequential. Agent may proceed only after a human OKs. On this repo, a push to main triggers a Vercel production deploy — so push is gated here, not allowed.
permissions.$comment_deny: Hard stop. Shell-metacharacter patterns can't live here (the parser rejects them) — those go in the PreToolUse hook (Layer 4).

$comment_hooks: Layer 4 — deterministic gates Claude cannot talk its way past, in EVERY permission mode. PreToolUse can BLOCK (exit 2).

PreToolUse.$comment: Secret-file guard — blocks Read/Edit/Write of .env, keys, secrets/ even under bypassPermissions.
